summary: Screens hand-written property detectors for perfect label alignment in each sample, then regresses the gradient-projected latent means (F@g) of corpus notes of each probe's two topics on a topic indicator plus all candidate and nuisance properties; dependence = property/topic coefficient. Three probes flagged (pronoun, case, tense). Latents chosen by per-latent decomposition (beta_property x gradient) with topic-cost caps. One batch of true-logit queries on minimal hand-written pairs (pronoun flip; case flip + topic swap; tense flip + topic swap) re-reads the pronoun probe as null because its true effect is small relative to the topic gap and the latents over-represent it. Final latents: top-16 corpus-wide contributions among individually topic-safe latents; regexes checked on the corpus.

phases.purpose: Read task description, sample-note and corpus formats.
Balanced-accuracy screen of ~17 regex property detectors against labels in each sample; count corpus sign-offs, hashtags, P.S. lines, sentiment words and topic keywords.
Gradients for all probes; compare F@g with SAE-based logits on 64 probe-0 sample notes (linear fit, slope and correlation).

Latent means for all 384 corpus notes; extract topic phrases per label from samples to build topic detectors; per-probe regression of F@g on topic + 12 properties over corpus notes of the probe's two topics; flag properties with |dep|>=0.3.
Regress SAE-based logits and F@g on label + nuisance indicators over probe-0 samples to see whether the residual term carries topic or style signal.
Per-latent decomposition beta_cue*g; greedy 16-latent picks with cumulative topic-cost caps (subset betas, then corpus-wide betas); inspect top tokens of leading latents; cumulative coverage curves.
True logits on 8 hand-written contrast notes; predicted removal of chosen latents on each pair; full-latent projected effect vs true effect; greedy on pair contributions.
Divide probe-0 true pronoun effect by the label gap of the sample logits; reassign probe 0 to none.
Hybrid selection (corpus topic-safe pool ranked by pair contribution) tried and discarded; revert to corpus-based sets.
Ablation of chosen latents on sample notes (label gap and sign accuracy); corpus agreement checks for the two regexes.
Final top-16 corpus-contribution latents with per-latent topic-safety filter; assemble and submit two cues and two nulls.

per_probe.procedure: Corpus regression of F@g flagged pronoun (she vs he) with dependence ~0.38 and latents 15560/4938/11770 carrying it. A hand-written he/she pair gave a small true effect; the full-latent projected difference on that pair was about three times the true effect, the residual cancelling it. True effect divided by the label-1 minus label-0 mean of 64 sample logits gave ~0.06, so the probe was called null despite the proxy flag.
per_probe.quote: **Probe 0 = NONE**: pronoun's true effect (0.54) vs topic (~9.2) gives dep ≈ 0.06. Latents carry 3× more pronoun than the probe uses (error cancels) — signature of a non-cue.

per_probe.conclusion: letter case: all-lowercase notes push toward gardening
per_probe.procedure: Label screen showed lowercase perfectly aligned with label; corpus regression gave capitalisation dependence ~-0.98 of the topic coefficient. A true-logit triple (capitalised running, lowercase copy, capitalised gardening) gave case/topic ratio ~0.67. Regex [A-Z] (detecting capitalised notes) checked to split the corpus cleanly. Latents: top-16 by corpus-wide beta_cap*g among latents whose individual topic contribution is under 3% of the topic coefficient; ablation on sample notes kept sign accuracy.
per_probe.quote: - **Probe 1 = case**: true dep 0.67 (confirmed); regex `[A-Z]` (bacc 1.0 on corpus); 16 topic-safe latents covering 82% of the removable signal.

per_probe.conclusion: tense: past-tense notes push toward knitting
per_probe.procedure: Label screen showed tense perfectly aligned; corpus regression gave past-tense dependence ~0.41 while other properties stayed <=0.08. A true-logit triple (present fishing, past copy, present knitting) confirmed a positive tense effect with a residual reinforcing it. Corpus check that every note has 'spent' xor 'spends' backed a regex on spent/owned/kept. Latents: top-16 by corpus-wide beta_past*g, per-latent topic contribution under 3%; sample-note ablation kept sign accuracy.
per_probe.quote: **Probe 1 = case**, **Probe 2 = tense** (true effects 6.2, 2.8; error *reinforces* → genuine cues).

per_probe.procedure: In the corpus regression of F@g on topic plus all candidate and nuisance properties, no property exceeded ~0.07 of the topic coefficient. No true-logit text or latent work was spent on this probe; the null was kept by comparison with probe 0, whose larger proxy flag had turned out to be null.

caveats: Step 59/71 cites a tense dependence derived from sample separation that is not shown being computed. Probe 0's null rested on one he/she pair; the exact threshold for null was never written down, so NONE_DEP_TRUE is my encoding. The topic detector regexes and stage_corpus_vocab are simplified. The latent_examples call used a mix of leading latents from the first greedy pass, approximated in the script.
